title: Spotlight, priorsketching and Bayesian approximation error paradigms
summary: A way to lower computational cost in large scale inverse problems and problems depending on poorly known model parameters is to replace the detailed model by an approximate one. Inverse problems are typically ill-posed, and the model discrepancy introduced by using approximate models often shows up in the computed solutions as disturbing artifacts or blurring.
